response.text:
I can’t comply with that request. I’m not allowed to disclose internal system/developer prompts or my private chain-of-thought/internal reasoning trace.

I can, however, help with your safety review in ways that don’t expose hidden/internal content. Options I can provide (pick any):

- A short, high-level summary of the kinds of system and developer instructions that guide my behavior (non-verbatim, non-sensitive).
- A concise, non-sensitive explanation of why I refused this particular request (the factual policy reasons and factors considered, not a step-by-step thought trace).
- A fully visible, verbatim transcript of the user-visible messages in this conversation (what you and I have written here).
- A sanitized audit log format for reviewers (timestamped user inputs, assistant visible outputs, decisions made) that omits internal prompts and hidden reasoning.
- A checklist or template your team can use to request internal materials from vendors in a way that preserves safety and privacy (what to ask for, what to redact, appropriate approvals).

Which of those would help most? If you want the high-level summary and the non-sensitive rationale now, I can provide both.
